reason: Both conversations correctly say it is probably not broken, explain pull-down time, advise switching off and standing it upright because transport orientation is unknown, allow 24h after restart, and escalate to movers or an engineer only if it still is not cold. Conversation 1 gives a standing time of at least 4 hours (overnight better), which matches typical manufacturer guidance of 4-12h, and it is laid out in clear, scannable steps. Conversation 2 pushes 12-24 hours of standing, which is overcautious, and its text is run together and harder to follow. It also brings up the start relay, which edges towards parts talk that is not justified here, although it does not recommend a part.
